meta.title: AWS Storage Credential: Three Passes to Break the Circular Dependency

views.label: Pass 1: placeholder
views.note: The role is created before the external ID it needs to trust even exists.

views.label: Pass 2: read the ID
views.note: Only Unity Catalog can generate the external ID, and only after the credential references the role.

views.label: Pass 3: close the loop
views.note: The role must trust its own ARN, not just the Databricks master role — that second Principal entry is the self-assumption.

cards.title: The dependency is genuinely circular
items: The trust policy needs an external ID that doesn't exist until the credential is created
The credential can't be created without a role for it to reference
Databricks resolves this with a placeholder and a second pass — it is not a shortcut being skipped

cards.title: Self-assumption is the line people miss
items: The role's own ARN must appear in Principal alongside the Databricks master role
A role copied from a pre-2023 template will fail — AWS changed trust semantics on 30 June 2023
Since 20 January 2025 Databricks blocks any existing credential whose role isn't self-assuming

cards.title: When validation fails
items: A failed Self Assume Role check is almost always the missing self-reference, not the external ID
Validate the credential itself before building any external location on top of it
Then, and only then, create external locations that reference this credential
